name: employee-skill-progression-visual
description: Visual verification of employee skill progression: XP gain from a dispatched task tracked across tick checkpoints, task duration scaling by proficiency, the pending-action ghost preview persisting while its target employee is busy, the ghost disappearing once claimed, and the employee detail panel reflecting each change.

steps.description: Employee A (#1) — will be dispatched to real blasting work below.
Employee B (#2) — holds a different skill (driving.truck), so the second dispatch later has nobody else on the roster able to claim it, which is what keeps its ghost preview alive.

Left unmarked: hiring already grants the Rookie starting qualification (ROLE_STARTING_QUALIFICATION in Employee.ts); this only raises the level for the scenario's needs -- the player-facing path is `employee train`.

tickEmployees claims the dispatch: employee A becomes busy and taskTicksRemaining is seeded from BASE_TASK_DURATION_TICKS scaled by proficiency/need/living-quarters multipliers.

Checkpoint 0 — task in progress, ghost preview live at the second dispatch's target tile.
Checkpoint 1 (+10 ticks) — employee A's XP bar should show partial fill from the first task's per-tick XP gain; the ghost preview for the still-unclaimed second dispatch should still be visible.

Checkpoint 2 (+60 ticks, 71 cumulative) — long enough for the first task to complete at any proficiency level and for employee A to auto-claim the second dispatch once freed, which should make its ghost preview disappear.

Checkpoint 3 (+150 ticks, target 221 cumulative) — with real-time auto-tick no longer racing this scripted sequence (#406), tick advance is deterministic for seed:42 and a random event (politics_ev_mandate) reliably fires and auto-pauses at cumulative tick 125, 54 ticks into this step — the same event the game would show a player, not a bug this scenario should paper over. The next step resolves it so the remaining ticks below can still reach the intended final state.
event choose 0 -- follows a bare tick, so whether an event is pending is a random roll; there may be no dialog on screen. Deliberately left unmarked (Finding #15).
Remaining ticks to reach the checkpoint 3 target of 221 cumulative (125 + 96 = 221) now that the event no longer blocks them.
